newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Saudi Arabian share trading, value drop.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabian share trading, value drop.

text.p: The value and volume of shares traded in the Saudi stock market dropped last week, figures released on Sunday by the Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency (SAMA) showed.

SAMA, the kingdom's central bank, said 1.99 million shares worth 400 million riyals ($106.6 million) were traded in the week ending on Thursday, down from 2.4 million shares worth 446.9 million riyals a week earlier.
Quoting SAMA, the official Saudi Press Agency said shares of 56 firms were traded last week. Share prices of 29 firms rose, 14 fell and 13 were unchanged.
The agency said bank shares dominated trading with 818,817 shares worth 221.5 million riyals changing hands.
Cement shares came next with 568,007 shares worth 108.3 million riyals.
